figures.identification: The image is a bar chart of five age groups of electoral democracies (1-18, 19-30, 31-60, 61-90, 91+ years) for the world in 2023, source V-Dem; the page links the chart number-electoral-democracies-age, whose categories and year match. The image was made with V-Dem (2024): its bars (21, 15, 31, 14, 10) differ slightly from the chart's current data (V-Dem v16: 20, 15, 31, 15, 9); the ground truth is the chart's current data (decision 0003).
figures.image_title: Democracy is young in most countries
figures.image_subtitle: Number of electoral democracies worldwide by age in 2023. Electoral democracies are understood here as political systems that hold meaningful, free and fair, and multi-party elections.
